Valencian Community (Comunitat Valenciana) — スペイン旅行ガイド：見どころ・アクセス・名物グルメ

Valencia City of Arts and Sciences & Turia Gardens, Valencia Central Market & La Lonja de la Seda, Alicante Santa Bárbara Castle & Costa Blanca, Albufera Natural Park & Peñíscola. AVE / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed trains from Madrid to Valencia (1h50) and Alicante (2h15); Valencia (VLC) & Alicante (ALC) airports.

地域・州Valencian Community (Comunitat Valenciana)
主要拠点・ターミナル駅Valencia Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)
全都市・自治体一覧542

アクセス・交通機関

AVE / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed trains from Madrid to Valencia (1h50) and Alicante (2h15); Valencia (VLC) & Alicante (ALC) airports.

名物グルメ・郷土料理

  • Authentic Paella Valenciana
  • Arroz a banda & Fideuà
  • Horchata de chufa with fartons
  • Turrón de Jijona
  • Valencian oranges
